root_cause: The outer sandbox used canonical /usr/bin/python, but the inherited inner shell bootstrap selected /usr/bin/python3. The files were content-identical, yet their recorded paths and therefore runtime software identities differed.
fail_closed_behavior: The arm launcher rejected the authorization before creating an arm run directory or starting ct_train.py.
corrective_action: When ECT_Q256_LAUNCHER_IN_SANDBOX=1, require and exec canonical python explicitly; retain python3 only as the old-host bootstrap. Add a regression test, recommit, and regenerate Role E and authorization evidence.
reuse_policy: The stopped matrix and its smoke authorization are audit evidence only and cannot authorize a later source commit.
